name: GetSalesOrders
description: Retrieve a list of sales orders from the SAP ERP system. Trigger this function when the user wants to query, filter, or view sales orders based on customer ID/name, status, or creation date range.

customerIdOrName.description: Customer ID (e.g. 'CUST-1002') or partial customer name (e.g. 'Philly Bikes'). Use null or omit this property if the user does not specify a customer name or ID.

fromDate.description: The starting creation date for filtering orders, formatted strictly as YYYY-MM-DD. Use null or omit this property if the user does not specify a start date or date range.

toDate.description: The ending creation date for filtering orders, formatted strictly as YYYY-MM-DD. Use null or omit this property if the user does not specify an end date or date range.

status.description: Filter orders by their current workflow status. Use null or omit this property if the user does not specify a status.

salesOrg.description: Optional sales organization code. Use null or omit this property if not specified.

top.description: Optional limit on records returned. Use null or omit this property if not specified.
